title: STARR-seq Screening protocol
protocol: Remove medium from cells completely.
Wash cells carefully with 10 ml PBS, remove PBS completely.
Add 1x Trypsin to the cells to cover the plate/flask completely.
Incubate cells on 37°C for 4-5 min until cells completely detach.
Add 12 ml medium to the cells, resuspend by pipetting up and down thoroughly.
Collect cells in a T-225 flask.
Count cells and use 8x10^7 / 8x10^8 cells for transfection.
Spin the cells down at 125xg for 5 min.
Remove the medium from the cells.
Resuspend pellets in 5 ml Electroporation buffer and pool all pellets in a 50 ml falcon tube.
Spin the cells down at 125xg for 5 minutes.
Remove the medium and add 500 µl of Electroporation buffer to the cells.
Resuspend the cells and add an appropriate amount of library, ensuring the concentration is > 1.0 µg/µl.
Use 80 µg library per 4x10^7 cells in 400 µl Electroporation buffer for each OC-400 cuvette.
Measure the volume and fill up to 800 µl with Electroporation buffer for a total of 8 ml if needed.
Add 400 µl cell suspension/DNA mix per OC-400 cuvette and electroporate using the cell-type specific pre-set protocols or optimization protocol.
Put 2x/10x EPOs into 1x pre-warmed T225 flask without adding medium.
Place cells in the incubator at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Repeat with additional 10 EPOs and place them in T225 flasks, including at 37°C for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, add 100 ml/350 ml medium without antibiotics to the cells.
Start counting the 6 hours incubation time after medium has been added to the cells.
Add 100 µl or 350 µl of a 1 mM stock of C16 and BX-795 inhibitors to the cells (final concentration 1 µM/inhibitor).
Close flasks and shake them to mix with inhibitors.
Harvest the medium of the cells (20% of cells are still not fully attached to the plates), add 10 ml PBS, harvest PBS.
Add 8 ml of 1x Trypsin, put cells in incubator at 37°C for 4-5 min.
Add 12 ml of medium (to save some medium: Re-use the pre-harvested medium to inactivate the trypsin), resuspend thoroughly and harvest.
Spin the cells down (in 50ml Falcon tubes) at 125xg for 5 min.
Remove medium.
Wash cells once with 10 ml/40 ml 1x PBS.
Spin the cells down (in 50 ml Falcon tubes) at 125xg for 5 min.
Remove 1x PBS but leave a rest of the 1x PBS (0.5 ml/1 ml) to cover the cells in the 50 ml falcon.
Resuspend the cells in the 1x PBS by softly flicking on the side of the 50 ml Falcon.
Work in an RNAse-free fume hood.
Use RNase Zap to clean all equipment.
Vortex resuspended cell pellet with 15 ml RLT (+β-ME) buffer.
Disrupt and homogenize cells using TissueRuptor for 4.5 min per cell pellet.
Add 15 ml 70% ethanol to the lysate and shake vigorously.
Transfer the mixture to an RNeasy Maxi column and centrifuge at >3200xg for 5 min, then discard flow-through.
Repeat with remaining 15 ml lysate/EtOH mix.
Add 15 ml RW1 buffer to the column and centrifuge at >3200xg for 5 min, then discard flow-through.
Add 10 ml RPE buffer to the column and centrifuge at >3200xg for 2 min, then discard flow-through.
Add another 10 ml RPE buffer and centrifuge at >3200xg for 10 min to dry the membrane, then discard flow-through.
Elute RNA with RNase-free H2O in three steps: first 1.2 ml, second 1 ml, third 0.5 ml.
Incubate each elution step for 2 min and centrifuge at >3200xg for 5 min.
Heat total RNA for 12 min at 65°C.
Place heated RNA on ice immediately for 5 min.
Wait for 1 min at room temperature.
Mix 1st, 2nd and 3rd elution fractions to obtain a pool with ~750 ng/μl.
Use 2x volume of Oligo(dT)25 beads for 1x volume of total RNA solution.
Resuspend Dynabeads Oligo(dT)25 beads thoroughly by vortexing to obtain a uniform brown suspension.
Distribute the resuspended beads to an appropriate tube and place the tube on a magnet.
Remove Storage Buffer completely from the beads.
Wash beads twice with 2x Binding Buffer: after adding buffer, mix and incubate beads on a magnetic separator for 1.5 min until solution is clear.
Resuspend the beads in half volume of 2x Binding Buffer.
Add 1 volume total RNA solution to 1 volume resuspended beads and mix gently by pipetting up and down.
Incubate on a rolling shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the magnet for 2 min and completely remove supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with Washing Buffer B: after adding buffer, mix gently by inverting the tube and incubate for 1.5 min on the magnetic separator.
Before elution, spin the tube very briefly and remove remaining buffer using a magnet.
Elute by adding 50 µl + 40 µl 10 mM Tris-HCl per 1 ml beads (starting volume); vortex.
Place beads on an 80°C heat block for 3 min; transfer tubes immediately to the magnet and incubate for 1 min.
Transfer supernatant to a new RNase-free tube.
Pool all first and second elutions from the same sample.
Measure RNA concentration of the final pool.
Safe 10 μl of pooled elution fractions for gel analysis.
Load appropriate amounts on gel based on determined RNA concentration, do not load more than 1 μg of RNA per lane.
Make a Master Mix for Turbo DNase I digestion by mixing 88 µl mRNA (max. 200ng/µl), 10 µl Turbo DNase Buffer, and 2.4 µl Turbo DNase I.
Invert the mixture gently.
Distribute 100 µl of Master Mix to PCR-stripes.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Pool 2 DNase reactions (or fill up with water to 200 µl) in 2 ml LoBind tubes.
Add 700 µl RLT buffer, vortex thoroughly.
Add 500 µl 100% EtOH, vortex.
Transfer the mixture to an RNeasy MinElute spin column (max. vol. 750 µl).
Centrifuge at 12000xg for 30 sec in a table top centrifuge and discard the flow-through.
Place the RNeasy MinElute spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube provided in the kit.
Add 500 µl RPE buffer, centrifuge at 12000xg for 30 sec and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µl 80% EtOH, centrifuge at 12000xg for 2 min and discard the flow-through.
Place the RNeasy MinElute spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube provided in the kit.
Centrifuge to dry the membrane for 5 min at full speed with open lid.
Elute RNA in 20 µl + 10 µl RNase-free H2O.
Incubate for 1 min.
Centrifuge for 3 min at full speed.
Pool eluates from all columns.
Measure RNA concentration of final pool.
Measure volume of final pool.
Save 5 µl of final pool for gel analysis.
Use 4-5 µg RNA per RT reaction.
Perform 1 negative control (RTminus/ RT-) by adding RNase-free H2O instead of SSIII.
If RNA concentration is low, do at least 5 reactions.
Prepare Master Mix according to specified volumes and components.
Distribute 65µl MM to PCR-stripes (5 reactions/tube).
Incubate at 65°C for 5 min.
Put on ice for 1 min.
Prepare enzyme mix per reaction: Add 4 µl 5x First-Strand buffer, 1 µl DTT, 1 µl RNaseOUT, and 1 µl SSIII (H2O for -RT control).
Add 35µl of the enzyme mix to the previous 65 µl reaction (5 reactions/tube: final vol.: 100µl).
Incubate at 50°C for 1 h.
Incubate at 70°C for 15 min.
Incubate at 4°C for ∞.
Store samples at -20°C if optional.
Add 1 µl RNaseA per 100 µl reaction (for 5 rxns).
Add 0.2 µl RNaseA per RT- rxn (= 20 µl).
Incubate for 1 h at 37°C.
Store samples at -20°C if optional.
Pool all cDNA samples.
Mix thoroughly.
Distribute up to 300 µl (for 15 RT rxns; keep RTminus separate) to LoBind 1.5ml tubes.
Mix/vortex beads thoroughly before use.
Add 1.8 volumes of beads to 1 volume of cDNA, vortex, and pipette up and down 20 times.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Place onto a magnet.
Incubate for 15 minutes on a magnetic stand.
Remove all liquid.
Wash twice with 1 ml of 80% EtOH, incubation time 2 minutes.
Dry beads at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Elute by adding 20 μl EB per reaction.
Take tubes off the magnet and pipette up and down 25 times.
Place tubes on a 37°C heat block, shake at 300 rpm for 3 minutes.
Put tubes immediately on a magnetic stand, carefully tilt to allow beads to migrate upwards on the wall, incubate for 1 minute.
Transfer supernatant (=sample) to a new tube.
Pool all cleaned cDNA samples (except RTminus).
Mix 20 μl of cDNA with 25 μl KAPA 2xHiFi and 2.5 μl junction fwd (10 µM) and 2.5 μl junction rev (10 µM), fill up to 50 μl with H2O.
Incubate at 98°C for 45 seconds, followed by 15 cycles of 98°C for 15 seconds, 65°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 70 seconds, then incubate at 72°C for 60 seconds.
Pool all reactions (up to 12 jPCR rxn = 600 μl), keep RTminus separate.
Measure the volume of pooled reactions.
Mix/vortex beads thoroughly before use.
Add 0.8 vol. beads to 1 vol. cDNA (40 µl for –RT), vortex, pipette up and down 20x.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature and another 15 min on a magnetic separator.
Remove all liquid.
Wash 2 times with 1 ml 80% EtOH, incubation time 2 min (beads have to be covered).
Dry beads at room temperature for 5-10 min (keep the tubes with open lids on the magnet).
Take tubes off magnets.
Elute in 20 µl H2O per rxn (25rxn, elute in 500 µl).
Pipette up and down 25x.
Place beads on a 37°C heat block, shake at 300 rpm for 3 min.
Put beads immediately on magnetic stand, carefully tilt stand to allow beads to migrate upwards on the wall, incubate for 1 min.
Transfer supernatant (=sample) to new tube.
Pool all cleaned jPCR samples (except RT-).
Perform a Test PCR to determine the number of cycles necessary.
Add 20 µl jPCR (from pool) to the PCR mix.
Add 2.5 µl PE1.0 (10 µM) to the PCR mix.
Add 2.5 µl MP2.0 (10 µM) to the PCR mix.
Mix and incubate at 98°C for 45 sec.
Cycle through 98°C for 15 sec, 65°C for 30 sec, and 72°C for 45 sec according to the number of cycles necessary (5-9 cycles).
Incubate at 72°C for 60 sec.
Analyze on a gel.
Mix 1% agarose gel.
Load 10 µl of each test PCR + 2 µl of 6x DNA loading dye onto the gel.
Determine the number of cycles based on band intensity after running 5 and 9 cycles.
If a faint band appears at 5 cycles, use 5 cycles.
If overamplification occurs at 5 cycles, reduce template amount accordingly for fewer cycles.
Do not adjust the cycle count for junction PCR.
Prepare a sequencing ready PCR mix with 20 µl jPCR (purified).
Add 2.5 µl PE1.0 (10 µM) to the PCR mix.
Include 2.5 µl TruSeq IDX (10 µM) with appropriate barcodes.
Combine with 25 µl KAPA 2x HiFi Mix.
Follow the PCR program and cycle number determined from test PCR results.
Pool 2 reactions or 10 reactions by pipetting out 45 µl of each reaction to get the exact volume required.
Mix/vortex beads thoroughly before use for purification.
Add 0.5 vol. beads to 1 vol. DNA, vortex, and pipette up and down 20 times.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnet in LoBind 1.5ml tube for another 5 minutes.
Collect the beads to the wall of the tube and ensure the solution is clear.
Remove all liquid from the tubes.
Wash the beads twice with 1 ml of 80% EtOH, incubating for 2 minutes each time.
Dry the beads at room temperature for 2-5 minutes with open lids on the magnet.
Elute by adding 10 μl RNase-free H2O per reaction (for 2 reactions: 20 μl, for 10 reactions: 100 μl).
Pipette up and down 25 times.
Place tubes on a heat block at 37°C for 3 minutes.
Tilt the magnetic stand to allow beads to migrate upwards on the wall, then incubate for 1 minute.
Transfer the supernatant (the sample) to a new tube.
Pool all cleaned sequencing-ready PCR samples except RTminus samples.
